Container.Name: ai-ledger
Container.Overview: Personal, lossless AI usage logger, raw transcript archive, and local monitoring dashboard for Codex, Claude Code, Antigravity, T3 Code, and Hermes.

Config.Name: Web UI & Ingest Port
Config.Description: HTTP port for the dashboard and collector ingest API. Restrict access via Tailscale or your local LAN.

Config.Name: Database Directory (Cache/Appdata)
Config.Description: Fast SSD storage for the SQLite database (ai-ledger.sqlite), WAL files, and pre-migration backups.

Config.Name: Raw Archive Directory (Array Share)
Config.Description: Persistent share (recommended: Primary Cache -> Secondary Array) for the lossless raw session archive and historical snapshots.

Config.Name: Bind Address
Config.Description: Internal bind address inside the container.

Config.Name: Data Path (Container)
Config.Description: Path inside the container for the database and raw archive.

Config.Name: Keep All Snapshots
Config.Description: Preserve every historical version of overwritten snapshots in /data/archive/versions/.

Config.Name: Admin Token (Optional)
Config.Description: Optional Bearer token to protect /api/admin/* endpoints (device creation, revocation, reparse).

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone name for timestamps and logs.
